name: Encore Engine
description: Most shots fire a free Encore shot right after (it uses no ammo). Each bullet hits a bit softer.
holyDescription: Most shots fire a free Encore shot right after (it uses no ammo).
details: An Encore is a full copy of your shot (same bullets, effects and damage) a moment later. It's free: it uses no ammo and still fires if the shot before it emptied your mag. Encores don't trigger more encores. Every full point of Encore is a guaranteed encore; the rest is the chance of one more.
